job_alert_sources.freshness: Weekly digest; read any digest from the last 7 days and rely on the duplicate check.

avoid_roles: Data Analyst / BI / Data Science roles whose essential criteria are strong SQL or Python
Finance roles needing an accounting qualification (CIMA, ACA, ACCA)

visa.notes: Skilled Worker route. New-entrant rate applies when switching from Student/Graduate visa (or under 26). A sponsor licence means the employer CAN sponsor, not that this role will: always read the advert's right-to-work wording, and check the job's SOC code going rate before applying.

skill_limits.about: What the owner can honestly claim. Never score or write above this level.
skill_limits.sql: Working knowledge only (select, filter, join, group by). Counts as half-evidenced when an advert asks for SQL, and as NOT met when it asks for strong/advanced SQL.
skill_limits.python: Used in degree projects with AI assistance; cannot write it unaided. Counts as NOT met when Python is an essential requirement.
skill_limits.strengths: Requirements, business rules, process mapping, stakeholder work, user acceptance testing, Power BI, Excel, defining and delivering internal tools with AI coding assistants.

web_discovery.about: Jobs found on the web through Firecrawl, in addition to alert emails. See CLAUDE.md step 4b.
web_discovery.watchlist_query: "{employer}" careers ("business analyst" OR "product analyst" OR "junior business analyst" OR "graduate analyst") UK
web_discovery.watchlist_note: Every employer here had a Skilled Worker licence on the register dated 2026-11-11. A licence means the employer can sponsor, not that a given role will.
